title.description: Sidebar section head above the fiddle's npm packages.

addPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the sidebar search field that finds npm packages to add to the fiddle.

addLabel.description: Accessible name of the sidebar field that searches npm for a package to add.

searching.description: Shown in the package search results while npm is being searched.

noResults.description: Shown in the package search results when npm has no matching package.

searchFailed.description: Shown in the package search results when the npm search service can't be reached.

latest.description: Right-aligned hint next to a package's newest version in the version list. Lower case, like a tag.

version.description: Accessible name of the version menu on a package row. {{name}} is the npm package name.

remove.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that removes a package from the fiddle. {{name}} is the npm package name.

addFailed.description: Toast title when a package can't be added to the fiddle. {{name}} is the npm package name.

changeFailed.description: Toast title when a package's version can't be changed or it can't be removed. {{name}} is the npm package name.

list.description: Accessible name of the list of npm packages the fiddle uses.
